name: Hiiragi Hinata
source:
Main heroine of the novel.

[url=/c1344]Natsuki[/url]'s former teacher and first love. The owner of the coffee-shop for now. Has a younger sister named Nanase, who tries to pretend to be her daughter and a twin-sister Natsuki. Unfussy in nature. Bright, popular among students. Unaware that she is basically liked by the opposite sex. In fact, a lot of boys liked her, including [url=/c1344]Natsuki[/url], who couldn't confess her at that time. A few years ago, she lost her parents same as [url=/c1344]Natsuki[/url].

[Edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=31461]Getchu[/url]]
